title: Dr. Pezeshkian: If our enemies are warriors, they should fight us, not the livelihoods of the people and their infrastructure.
text:
Dr. Pezeshkian: If our enemies are warriors, they should fight us, not the livelihoods of the people and their infrastructure."

"The President of our country, in a meeting with religious leaders, intellectuals, and merchants of India:"

"🔸If there is to be a war, it should be fought against the opposing side; however, targeting infrastructure, people's livelihoods, and their lives is an inhumane act."

"🔸Blocking access to water and food, or creating restrictions for the people with the aim of forcing a nation to surrender, is not compatible with human principles."

"🔸The people of Iran, based on their human and religious beliefs, will not surrender to pressure and coercion
